An '''apple''' is a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Regeneration}}. Eaten raw, it heals {{Value|Apple|heals}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/food/minecraft/apple.json}}</ref> Cooked into a [[Baked Apple|baked apple]], preserved as [[Canned Apples|canned apples]] or baked into an [[Apple Empanada|apple empanada]], it grants Regeneration for {{Value|Baked Apple|duration|effect=Regeneration}}, {{Value|Canned Apples|duration|effect=Regeneration}} and {{Value|Apple Empanada|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.

== Obtaining ==

=== Breaking ===
Oak and dark oak leaves drop apples. The leaves' loot table has two independent apple rolls when broken without shears or Silk Touch, each with a 0.75% chance: one is increased by Fortune and the other by the Electrum tool [[intrinsic]], both to 0.9%, 1.5%, 2% and 4% at levels I to IV.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/oak_leaves.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating an apple heals {{Value|Apple|heals}}. It keeps its vanilla nutrition, which has no lasting effect because [[hunger]] is removed.

Picking up an apple unlocks the [[Baked Apple|baked apple]] recipe. Apples are cooked into baked apples before they can be preserved or baked, and are also used raw in [[Golden Apple|golden apple]]s, [[Apple Cinnamon Oatmeal|apple cinnamon oatmeal]] and [[mead]].
